info.title: WebEngine CLI - persistent local browser and mobile automation
info.description: WebEngine CLI and local daemon for persistent Selenium browser automation sessions.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit a machine-readable response on stdout.

options.name: --pipe
options.description: Override the default per-user named pipe.

options.name: --headless
options.description: Start the browser without a visible window.

options.name: --ref
options.description: Reference returned by the latest inspection.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Native WebEngine locator: HTML tag name.

options.name: --element-text
options.description: Native WebEngine locator: exact visible element text.

options.name: --link-text
options.description: Native WebEngine locator: exact hyperlink text.

options.name: --class
options.description: Native WebEngine locator: CSS class name.

options.name: --index
options.description: Zero-based match index when a locator matches many.

options.name: --text
options.description: Text to type or visible option text to select.

options.name: --text-file
options.description: Read UTF-8 text from a file instead of the command line.

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Read all text from standard input.

options.name: --key
options.description:
Named key to send: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace,
Delete, Space, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, or ArrowUp/
ArrowDown/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

options.name: --app
options.description: Local APK/IPA path or cloud app reference.

options.name: --cloud-provider
options.description:
Cloud provider. Credentials are read from environment
variables only. Leave empty to auto-detect from --appium-url.

options.name: --capabilities
options.description:
JSON object of extra Appium capabilities. NEVER pass
credentials here — use BROWSERSTACK_USERNAME /
BROWSERSTACK_ACCESS_KEY or PERFECTO_TOKEN.

options.name: --pin-secure
options.description:
Encrypted device PIN for 'mobile unlock', produced by
Encrypter.Encrypt. Never pass a plaintext PIN.
